publicReleaseNotes: Chest 0.2.0 is a team file store you own, a free, open source replacement for the everyday storage and sharing of Google Drive, Dropbox or Box, run on your own computer or your own Cloudflare account. Team spaces and nested folders with uploads from the browser and the phone camera; large uploads that resume where they stopped; file version restore and restoring a whole folder to a date with a preview and undo; links for anyone with a password, expiry and download limit, revoke, and Shared too widely with Make private; file requests anyone can upload to, with an email to you on a hosted Chest; search inside PDFs and Office files limited to what each person may open; space roles from viewer to manager, item sharing and access requests; email sign-in and invitations on a hosted Chest; local and hosted backup and restore; plus move-in from Google Takeout, Dropbox and Box downloads, company sign-in with SCIM, storage limits, trash and an audit trail, and the 0.1.0 governed records Library. Not in this release: desktop and phone sync apps, a full Office editor or editing together, carrying sharing, links and versions over from other services, certified single sign-on, and scheduled off-site backups. Back up first with rer export on your own computer or rer run hosted-backup for a hosted Chest. Upgrading from 0.1.0 adds tables only and keeps every row and original. The checkout pins rer 0.2.51.
agentUpdateInstructions: From 0.1.0 or an earlier main checkout: back up first. On your own computer stop Chest and run rer export --output exports/chest-before-0.2.0.rer in the run-chest folder. For a hosted Chest, from the checkout that deployed it (with its .rer/deploy folder and settings file), run rer run hosted-backup --environment NAME --env-file chest.env; rer export saves only the local copy and refuses a hosted address. Then, in the same checkout, git pull and rer install, and rer dev on your computer or rer deploy --environment NAME --env-file chest.env for a hosted Chest. Migrations 0016 to 0020 apply forward only and only create tables; a 0.1.0 copy upgraded in place kept every row and original unchanged. New install: npx -y @runeditrun/rer dev just-every/run-chest (or rer setup just-every/run-chest --owner-email OWNER --owner-name NAME, then rer dev), which installs the pinned rer 0.2.51 and applies migrations 0001 to 0020. Restore a .rer archive with rer import --input FILE --yes into a fresh checkout, then rer setup and rer dev; restore a hosted backup folder into a freshly deployed environment with rer run hosted-restore --environment NAME --input exports/FOLDER --env-file chest.env, then re-enter company sign-in and any AI model key. Mail, company sign-in and the AI model key stay off until the owner adds their own; Chest on your own computer sends no email. Run rer verify before adopting.
